tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: The window's background. Cream, never white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, the map's frame, the composer's field, a neutral cluster in the graph.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Cards and blocks that sit on the page: messages, stubs, acceptance requests.

tokens.name: titlebar
tokens.usage: The title bar and the footer.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between things: list rows, dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of cards, inputs and the graph's ring track.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The graph's edges between clusters, and tethers. Lines only, never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, names and links. 7.9:1 on page, 8.2:1 on raised.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text. 7.1:1 on page, 6.7:1 on surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: times, counts, captions, graph labels. 5.2:1 on page, 4.9:1 on surface.

tokens.name: moved-fill
tokens.usage: Soft purple: what moved, a row under the pointer, the moved chip's fill. Text on it stays ink or text.

tokens.name: moved-selected
tokens.usage: Stronger purple: the chosen option in a list or a control, and the main action button. Text on it stays ink (5.3:1) or text (4.8:1).

tokens.name: moved-mark
tokens.usage: Icons, arcs, arrows and the working ring for what moved. A mark, not text.

tokens.name: moved-word
tokens.usage: Pastel purple words for what changed or is under way by the agent, on the page, as Wisteria Lily writes changed file names. 2.5:1 on page: below 4.5:1 by choice, so it is used at 13 px and up, weight 500, and never as the only sign.

tokens.name: moved-strong
tokens.usage: The one strong purple: a small filled badge with a count in page colour (4.7:1), and the moved chip's word (4.0:1 on moved-fill, below 4.5:1 by choice).

tokens.name: done-fill
tokens.usage: Fill for what is done or settled: merged, passed, approved, accepted, succeeded.

tokens.name: done-mark
tokens.usage: Dots, the settled share of a ring, a check mark. A mark, not text.

tokens.name: done-word
tokens.usage: Words on done-fill. 4.6:1 on done-fill, 5.1:1 on page.

tokens.name: review-fill
tokens.usage: Fill for what is under way elsewhere: a pull request open, checks running, someone else reviewing.

tokens.name: review-mark
tokens.usage: Dots and marks for what is under way elsewhere. A mark, not text.

tokens.name: review-word
tokens.usage: Words on review-fill. 4.9:1 on review-fill, 5.4:1 on page.

tokens.name: waiting-fill
tokens.usage: Fill for what waits on a person, and for a failure, which also waits on one.

tokens.name: waiting-mark
tokens.usage: Dots, hairlines and the failure's dashed outline. A mark, not text.

tokens.name: waiting-word
tokens.usage: Words on waiting-fill. 5.1:1 on waiting-fill, 5.6:1 on page.

tokens.name: idle-line
tokens.usage: The hairline of something not started; it has no fill.

tokens.name: loop-mark
tokens.usage: The dashed ring of an open loop: a path that stops before an answer.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Captions, times, graph labels, in muted.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Block titles and names, in ink.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside a chip, between a mark and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip padding across.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every line around a box: cards, stubs, inputs, switches, a chip's outline. On a Retina screen it draws one device pixel.

tokens.name: hairline-dashed
tokens.usage: The dashed outline of a failure or an open loop: a touch heavier, so the dashes still read.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: State chips and pills, as on the delivery board.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and blocks.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Discs, dots, the working ring.
